description: A common benign warty lesion that appears during adult life and is associated with skin ageing.
symptoms: An irritated lesion may become inflamed or crusted

appearance.general: A flat or raised papule or plaque with a smooth, waxy, or warty surface and a characteristic 'stuck-on' appearance; colours range from skin-coloured or yellow to brown or black.

warning_signs: A lesion that is diagnostically uncertain, rapidly changing, or difficult to distinguish from skin cancer should be assessed by a clinician.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss any changing, irritated, or atypical lesion.
A biopsy may be considered when the diagnosis is uncertain.
